magic-code.subject: Your Acme login code
magic-code.heading: Sign in to Acme
magic-code.body: Enter this code in the window where you started. It expires in 10 minutes.
magic-code.closing: If you did not try to sign in, ignore this email. Never share this code with anyone. Write to {supportLink} if you are worried about your account.
welcome.subject: Welcome to Acme
welcome.heading: Welcome to Acme
welcome.body: Your account is ready. Have a look around, and tell us what you think.
welcome.closing: You received this email because an account was created at {siteLink}.
booking-confirmation.subject: Your booking for {activityName} is confirmed
booking-confirmation.heading: Booking confirmed
booking-confirmation.intro: Your booking for {activityName} is confirmed for {participantCount} people.
booking-confirmation.closing: Questions about this booking? Write to {supportLink}.
